title: DpiCommand
description: Message sent to bus to control DPI functions

eventTimestamp.description: The timestamp when the message was created/sent

traceId.description: A unique identifier (UUIDv4) for this message

clientId.description: Set this to "*" to send the command to all clients on the vehicle. If you want to target a specific client, put its clientId here.

command.description: The command you want to send
